title: The Myth of Perfectionism
hook: "Are you willing to accept 'good enough' as a benchmark for success?"
script: A person is shown trying to achieve perfection in various aspects of life - work, relationships, and personal growth. However, each time they reach a milestone, they become increasingly dissatisfied and strive for even more. The script then cuts to a person embracing the concept of "good enough" and finding peace in accepting their limitations.
caption: "Challenging the myth that perfection is the only path to success. First-principles thinking says that 'good enough' can be, well, good enough. Share your thoughts on this one! #RationalThoughts #Perfectionism #PersonalGrowth"
